# Aldersyde Distribution - vehicle logs

One log for each vehicle, kept under the depot the vehicle works from.
Two depots each run a vehicle carrying the fleet number T-14, one at
Kemsley and one at Rothwell.

turns.prompt: Aldersyde Distribution is reconciling the September mileage claim. How many miles did T-14 cover in September?
The Kemsley vehicle. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
